checks: Relative to 1 mW, powers 1, 10, 100 and 1000 mW have levels 0, 10, 20 and 30 dB.
Cascaded power gains of two and five produce a gain of ten, or 10 dB.
Positive power 0.1 mW has relative level -10 dB.
proof: For positive ratios r = 10^a and s = 10^b, their product is 10^(a+b). Therefore log10(rs) = log10(r) + log10(s). Multiplication by ten gives the power-level difference in decibels.
limits: Power ratios require a stated reference. The film makes no claim about perceived loudness, field-amplitude ratios, or adding simultaneous sources.
